name: image-enhance
description: Strengthen Codex image workflows with isolated generation, animated GIF creation, and efficient folder review.

interface.shortDescription: Stronger image creation, GIF, and folder review workflows.
interface.longDescription: Create or edit raster images through distinct serial imagegen workers, build and verify animated GIFs with a deterministic cross-platform pipeline, and review image-heavy folders through labeled contact sheets.
defaultPrompt: Use $image-enhance:create to create a raster image through an isolated worker.
Use $image-enhance:create-gif to build a looping GIF from generated art, a sprite sheet, or image frames.
Review and compare all images in this folder.
